_comment: Frozen table of a room's settings. A room setting is a memory at
settings/<id>: its value in the frontmatter as `setting:`, the reason for
it in the body, versioned and discussable like any memory. The hub checks
every write to settings/ against this table at the memory upsert
CLI's `memory set` and an agent all get the same 422. A setting with
`inherits` takes the hub's value (that config.toml key) until the room sets
its own; `at_most_hub` means a room may lower the hub's value, never raise
